viewed_complete_captures.notes: Viewed the complete native viewport. Hankou/Hanyang/Wuchang captions and two ferry captions remain readable and clear of the models; ships, garrisons and ground remain distinguishable. The tiny dated theatre leaves blank margins at this camera scale; the river is still angular and the floodplain is overly uniform.

Viewed the complete native viewport of campaign_1924_05, not the rejected Shanhaiguan fixture. Beijing caption is retained beside the dense formations. Buildings and troops have smaller silhouettes; countryside detail, garrison marker density and landscape composition remain unfinished.

Viewed the complete native viewport. Dongjiakou, Chengziyu and Banchangyu labels clear their small building silhouettes; individual mountains are legible. Mountain bases still look isolated and minor rivers form angular, sometimes isolated-looking branches. Ground lacks convincing local detail.
